title: Phishing-led credential theft on the finance mailbox
detected_by: Mail gateway alert, confirmed by the SOC
summary: A finance user entered credentials on a look-alike login page. The attacker signed in and created a forwarding rule. The account was contained within 50 minutes of detection.

events.description: User entered credentials on the fake page
Gateway flagged a login from an unusual country
Sessions revoked, password reset, forwarding rule removed
Look-alike domain taken down; message pulled from all mailboxes
Account restored with a phishing-resistant MFA method

root_cause: The account used SMS-based MFA and a one-time code was relayed through the fake page.
impact: One mailbox compromised for about 1h25m. No evidence of data download beyond 36 forwarded messages.
what_went_well: Gateway alert fired within minutes of the unusual login
Sessions were revoked before the forwarding rule was used again
what_went_wrong: The look-alike domain was registered 2 days earlier and was not blocked
SMS MFA was still allowed for finance staff

action_items.item: Require passkeys or hardware keys for finance staff
Block domains younger than 14 days at the mail gateway
